aadhaar.name: Aadhaar card
aadhaar.how_to_get: Enrol or update at an Aadhaar centre or at uidai.gov.in; carry proof of identity and address.

bank_passbook.name: Bank passbook / account details (Aadhaar-linked)
bank_passbook.name_hi: बैंक पासबुक / खाता विवरण (आधार से जुड़ा)
bank_passbook.how_to_get: Open a savings account at any bank or post office (a Jan Dhan account needs only Aadhaar) and link it with Aadhaar.

mobile_number.name: Mobile number (preferably linked with Aadhaar)
mobile_number.name_hi: मोबाइल नंबर (आधार से जुड़ा हो तो बेहतर)
mobile_number.how_to_get: Use your own active number; update it at an Aadhaar centre if it is not linked.

land_records.name: Land ownership records (Khasra/Khatauni/Jamabandi)
land_records.how_to_get: Download from your state land-records portal or get a copy from the Patwari / Tehsil office.

ration_card.name: Ration card
ration_card.how_to_get: Apply through your state food & civil supplies department or the nearest Fair Price Shop / CSC.

job_card.name: MGNREGA job card
job_card.how_to_get: Apply at your Gram Panchayat; it is issued free of cost.

income_certificate.name: Income certificate
income_certificate.how_to_get: Apply at the Tehsil / SDM office or your state e-District portal.

address_proof.name: Address proof
address_proof.how_to_get: Aadhaar, voter ID, utility bill or rent agreement is usually accepted.

affidavit_no_pucca_house.name: Self-declaration that you do not own a pucca house
affidavit_no_pucca_house.name_hi: स्वघोषणा कि आपके पास पक्का मकान नहीं है
affidavit_no_pucca_house.how_to_get: Written on plain paper or a notarised affidavit as required by the application portal.

girl_birth_certificate.name: Birth certificate of the girl child
girl_birth_certificate.how_to_get: Issued by the municipality / Gram Panchayat registrar of births.

passport_photo.name: Passport-size photograph
passport_photo.how_to_get: Recent colour photographs from any photo studio.

pan.name: PAN card
pan.how_to_get: Apply at incometax.gov.in or through a PAN service centre.

business_proof.name: Business proof (Udyam registration / trade licence / shop licence)
business_proof.name_hi: व्यवसाय का प्रमाण (उद्यम पंजीकरण / ट्रेड लाइसेंस / दुकान लाइसेंस)
business_proof.how_to_get: Udyam registration is free at udyamregistration.gov.in; trade licences come from the local municipal body.

vending_certificate.name: Certificate of Vending / ID card / Letter of Recommendation from the local body
vending_certificate.name_hi: वेंडिंग प्रमाण पत्र / पहचान पत्र / नगर निकाय की अनुशंसा पत्र
vending_certificate.how_to_get: Request from your Urban Local Body (municipality) or Town Vending Committee.

age_proof.name: Age proof (birth certificate / school certificate / voter ID)
age_proof.name_hi: आयु का प्रमाण (जन्म प्रमाण पत्र / स्कूल प्रमाण पत्र / वोटर आईडी)
age_proof.how_to_get: Use any one government-issued document showing date of birth.

bpl_certificate.name: BPL certificate / BPL list entry
bpl_certificate.name_hi: बीपीएल प्रमाण पत्र / बीपीएल सूची में नाम
bpl_certificate.how_to_get: Obtain from the Gram Panchayat / Block office or your state's BPL portal.

mcp_card.name: Mother and Child Protection (MCP) card / pregnancy registration proof
mcp_card.name_hi: मातृ एवं शिशु सुरक्षा (एमसीपी) कार्ड / गर्भावस्था पंजीकरण प्रमाण
mcp_card.how_to_get: Register the pregnancy at the nearest Anganwadi centre or government health facility.

caste_certificate.name: Caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC)
caste_certificate.how_to_get: Apply at the Tehsil / SDM office or your state e-District portal.

marksheet.name: Previous year marksheet
marksheet.how_to_get: Issued by your school / college / university.

admission_proof.name: Admission proof / fee receipt of the current course
admission_proof.name_hi: वर्तमान पाठ्यक्रम का प्रवेश प्रमाण / फीस रसीद
admission_proof.how_to_get: Get it from your institution's office.

sowing_declaration.name: Sowing / crop declaration
sowing_declaration.how_to_get: Submit through your bank, CSC or the PMFBY portal at the time of enrolment.
